issuer.summary: Direct redemption is available to qualified Mint Users under Ethena BVI terms, based on the pro rata reserve share and capped at USD 1 per USDe. Secondary holders rely on liquidity or separately qualifying for direct access.
issuer.summary_source: DeFiAnalyst exact Ethereum component documentary review, November 27, 2026. Issuer 6.5 retained.
facts: Ethena BVI Limited distinguishes secondary holders from its customers. Only a whitelisted Mint User who clears onboarding and agrees to the Mint User Agreement can redeem directly. Ethena BVI or its designated affiliate commits to deliver supported digital assets worth the pro rata reserve share per USDe, capped at USD 1 notional, subject to terms, law and fees. Holding USDe conveys no reserve income. Secondary holders depend on market liquidity unless admitted.

Ethena describes institutional custody and off-exchange settlement for hedges. The October 21 provider statements cover specified accounts, collateral or positions at that date. Loan principal, pledged collateral and nested custody statements overlap. No current consolidated audit, holder-specific title, insolvency priority or executable redemption capacity was established. No newer packet was identified in the issuer blog index.
The historical ENA fee-switch proposal replaced the earlier Reserve-Fund-first parameters. Its stated supply milestones are not proof of current activation.
issuer.issuer_score_basis: November17 assessment: Ethena BVI terms distinguish Holding Users from approved Mint Users; no universal bank-cash/insured repayment claim. Expanded public lending/custody disclosure improves visibility while anonymous groups, scope differences and recovery limits remain. October documentary acceptance is not a renewed legal, conduct or governance audit.
issuer.issuer_score_persistence: Recheck at fee-switch activation, a governance redesign or a material operational failure.
